articles.title: Fire Tender Called In to Wash BJP MLA’s Car? Viral Video Sparks Outrage in Madhya Pradesh | WATCH
articles.description: A controversial video from Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh, shows a BJP MLA's car allegedly being washed by a fire tender, sparking widespread online outrage. The incident has raised concerns about the misuse of public services and power by government officials, with many calling for action.

articles.title: Hyderabad Metro speeds up purchase of 10 new coaches
articles.description:

Ajith Reddy holding discussions with the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) in Delhi last week. DMRC representatives are expected to visit Hyderabad soon. HMRL is also expected to approve the quotations submitted by DMRC for [...]HYDERABAD: Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited (HMRL) has stepped up the process of procuring additional coaches, with Additional Managing Director B. Ajith Reddy holding discussions with the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) in Delhi last week.

DMRC representatives are expected to visit Hyderabad soon. HMRL is also expected to approve the quotations submitted by DMRC for consultancy services.

The government has already decided to procure 10 new coaches. However, officials face the challenge of sourcing coaches that are technically compatible with the existing system in the first phase.

DMRC to assess specifications and manufacturers

According to metro officials, DMRC will oversee the process from finalising the specifications of the coaches to selecting and inspecting domestic manufacturers.

Officials are examining the consultancy fee sought by DMRC and whether it is in line with the fees the corporation has charged for providing similar services to other metro rail projects.

At the same time, HMRL officials are holding discussions with domestic companies that manufacture metro rail coaches.

Old City Metro tender may be finalised soon

The MGBS-Chandrayangutta 7.5-km corridor is considered a key section of the Old City Metro project. Land acquisition is in its final stage.

DMRC is expected to finalise the tender and technical aspects within two weeks.

SBI Caps is handling the refinancing arrangements required for the government to take over the first phase of the metro project. HMRL managing director Sarfaraz Ahmad is focusing on measures to complete the loan process within the stipulated timeframe.
